name: Alice Gets The Same Confirmed Booking In Every Channel
full_name: Business Journey.Workshop Booking.Alice Gets The Same Confirmed Booking In Every Channel
documentation: Preparation supplies an empty local application, a private PostgreSQL table and a fresh browser. Alice signs in and books API Testing for EUR 49.90. We check the GUI booking ID, the API's JSON, a separate database query and the downloaded PDF against approved fixtures. All channels must describe WB-1001 consistently.
